concepts.label: Audit retention
evidenceFragments: The retention policy for the audit-events container in the Compliance Service is 7 years (regulatory requirement). TTL is disabled on this container.

concepts.label: Immutable audit logging
evidenceFragments: All actions are logged to the immutable Log Analytics workspace.

concepts.label: Audit access control
evidenceFragments: The Compliance Auditor role can query audit records via the Compliance API but cannot modify them.

concepts.label: Service data isolation
evidenceFragments: Each service's Managed Identity is granted Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor role scoped to its own database resource only. No service can read or write to another service's database.

concepts.label: Idempotency
evidenceFragments: Idempotency keys are required on all POST and PATCH operations to support safe retries during transient failures.
